description: Implementation of the ClientSocketHandle class managing socket lifecycle, priorities, and error states within the net namespace.

classes.name: ClientSocketHandle
classes.description: Manages a network socket, including initialization, priority, error states, and lifecycle management within the net namespace.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the socket handle by requesting a socket from the pool with specified parameters.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of the socket handle if the socket is not yet initialized.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the socket handle, releasing resources and resetting error states.

methods.name: ResetAndCloseSocket
methods.description: Closes the socket if initialized and resets the handle.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns the current load state of the socket handle.

methods.name: IsPoolStalled
methods.description: Checks if the socket pool is stalled.

methods.name: AddHigherLayeredPool
methods.description: Adds a higher layered pool to the handle.

methods.name: RemoveHigherLayeredPool
methods.description: Removes a higher layered pool from the handle.

methods.name: CloseIdleSocketsInGroup
methods.description: Closes idle sockets in the group for the handle.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Retrieves load timing information for the socket.

methods.name: SetSocket
methods.description: Assigns a socket to the handle.

methods.name: SetAdditionalErrorState
methods.description: Sets error-related information based on a connect job.

methods.name: PassSocket
methods.description: Transfers ownership of the socket out of the handle.

methods.name: OnIOComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon I/O completion, handling the result.

methods.name: HandleInitCompletion
methods.description: Handles the completion of socket initialization, updating state and logging.

methods.name: ResetInternal
methods.description: Internal method to reset the handle's state, optionally canceling requests and connect jobs.

methods.name: ResetErrorState
methods.description: Resets error-related information to default states.
